messages:
oncall-bot: PagerDuty alert -> High 5xx rate on inference-prod (route: /v1/generate). current window 3m, error rate ~12%. auto-retry counts spiking. incident id PD-19012  

maria: Taking primary. quick snapshot: 5xx from model-server pool a, starts ~22:04 UTC. latency not elevated, so likely request processing failures. I'm starting log tail.

sam: on it as secondary. I'll check autoscaler and node churn. had recent scale policy change last week.

alex: I'll grab model-server logs and KV cache traces. ping me if you need me to roll a canary.

chen: I'll assess customer impact and update status page if >5% of requests affected. any heavy customers on Dedicated?

maria: Yes — cust: AcmeAnalytics has traffic routed to the affected pool. contact assigned (account: jess@acme).

oncall-bot: Deploybot: Canary deploy to serving-pool-a completed at 2026-03-12T21:58Z (version v2.3.9). No failed pods reported by deploybot.

sam: autoscaler logs: seeing rapid add/remove of pods in pool-a between 22:00-22:05. suspect OOM or liveness failing. attaching grep output snippet below:

```
kubectl -n serving logs deploy/model-server-a | grep -E "OOM|Killed process|liveness probe failed" -n | tail -n 50
2026-03-12T22:02:11Z model-server-a-5 Killed process 1342 (python) OOM
2026-03-12T22:02:12Z model-server-a-5 liveness probe failed
2026-03-12T22:03:02Z model-server-a-7 Killed process 1420 (python) OOM
```

alex: seeing repeated "KVCache: invalid pointer" in logs right before OOMs. could be memory leak with new quantized kernel.

maria: action plan: 1) remove pool-a from active routing (fallback to pool-b) -> mitigate customer impact 2) scale down pool-a to 0 for now 3) collect crash dumps and open ticket 4) schedule rollback of quantized kernel if needed.

ali: I'm about to take the handoff at 22:15 UTC. if you need me to own routing changes I can.

maria: please do. sam/aclex take the artifacts. I'm going to create incident ticket and notify Acme.

maria: created INC-9876 (internal incident) and JIRA-4321 for root cause + fix. linking runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/serving-ooms.

sam: removed pool-a from routing at 22:10 UTC. traffic shifted to pool-b. error rate dropped to 0.8% within 90s.

chen: status page draft: "Degraded - partial impact to inference-prod for a subset of customers. We are routing traffic away from affected pool. Investigating root cause." Will publish in 10m unless objections.

alex: collected core dumps and heap profiles. uploading to S3 -> s3://incidents/INC-9876/heap-22-03-12.tar.gz.

maria: big picture notes: likely mem regression from recent kernel change in v2.3.9. candidate revert: v2.3.8 quantization runtime.

ali: taking over as primary at 22:15 UTC. I will monitor for 30m and coordinate RCA owners.

maria: leaving as secondary until 22:45 UTC then off shift. alpha: I'm going offline but reachable by DM for 15m.

ali: action items being tracked in JIRA-4321: 1) fetch and analyze heap profiles (owner: alex) 2) reproduce in staging w/ v2.3.9 quant kernels (owner: sam) 3) prepare rollback plan + canary (owner: ali) 4) customer comms + billing hold review (owner: chen).

sam: quick note - we have a small coverage gap from 22:40-23:00 UTC (planned dinner). ali, can you arrange backup coverage or extend watch?

ali: I can extend until 23:15 UTC, then marta will take late shift. tagging @marta to confirm.

marta: confirmed, I will be primary from 23:15-02:00 UTC.

maria: post-handoff follow-ups: filing retro invite: "INC-9876 - Postmortem" scheduled 2026-03-13 15:00 PT. attendees: eng-runtime, eng-ml, devex, customer-success.

chen: created customer support ticket CS-1129 to notify Acme and offered mitigation credits.

alex: current mitigation status: rollback prepared and tested in staging. canary ready if we decide.

ali: for now we're keeping pool-a drained and using pool-b. next steps this shift: reproduce locally, evaluate rollback risk, confirm no data loss, and complete JIRA tasks.

maria: logging one more runbook pointer for handoff notes: https://redwood.internal/handoffs/templates/serving-incident. use that template for future handoffs.

marta: ack, will monitor metrics and notify if anything >1% error for 5m.

ali: leaving summary for next oncall: errors caused by OOMs tied to quantized kernel in v2.3.9; immediate mitigation = drain affected pool and route to healthy pool; tickets filed INC-9876, JIRA-4321, CS-1129; retro scheduled.

oncall-bot: Handoff recorded: primary ali -> marta at 23:15 UTC. new oncall roster updated.

marta: thanks all. closing thread for now, will reopen if we see regressions. :white_check_mark:
